content:
The image shows a tomato leaf with large, irregular tan-to-brown lesions. The lesions have a distinct fluffy, velvety gray-brown texture (visible spore mass) on the surface, which is the hallmark sign of Botrytis (Gray Mold). The coloration and texture match the description closely: tan-to-brown lesions with a dense velvety gray-brown spore mass. The lesions are irregular, not concentric-ringed (ruling out Early Blight), and there are no water-soaked greasy margins with white sporulation on undersides (ruling out Late Blight). No yellow halos, no V-shaped patterns, no powdery white coating.
